verses.en: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,
verses.sm: Aikupito ona o a latou agasala O le upu na oo mai ia leremia ia luta uma sa nonofo i le nuu o Aikupito, sa nonofo i Mekatala, ma Tapenesa, ma Nafi, ma le nuu o Patoro, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Ye have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Judah; and, behold, this day they are a desolation, and no man dwelleth therein,
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o ‘au, le Atua o Isaraelu, Ua outou vaaia le malaia uma na ou faaoo i luga o [erusalema, ma luga o aai uma o Iuta; faauta foi, ua faatafunaina i le aso nei, e leai foi se tagata ua nofo ai;

verses.en: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, and to serve other gods, whom they knew not, neither they, ye, nor your fathers.
verses.sm: ona o a latou amio leaga na latou faia, e faaonoono mai ai ia te au, ina ua latou 6 e faamu mea manogi e auauna ai i atua ese, o e na latou le iloa, o i latou, po o outou, po o outou tama.

verses.en: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.
verses.sm: Na a‘u aauina atu foi ia te outou aʻu auauna uma o perofeta, na ou ala aauina atu i latou, ua faapea atu, Aua lava neʻi outou faia lena mea inosia, o le mea lava ou te ‘ʻinoʻino i ai.

verses.en: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.
verses.sm: SA e lei faalogo mai : latou, ma ua le uai mai O latou tal:ga, ina ia liliu mai i a latou amio eaga, aua le faamu mea manogi i atua ese.

verses.en: Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as at this day.
verses.sm: O lea ua liligiina ifo ai loʻu ita ma loʻu tiga, ma ua mu ai i aai o Iuta, ma ala o Ierusalema; ua faatafunaina foi ia, ua tuufua, e pei ona fai i le aso nei.

verses.en: Therefore now thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; Wherefore commit ye this great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Judah, to leave you none to remain;
verses.sm: O lenei, o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALY, le Atua o “an, le Atua o Isaraelu, Se a le mea ua outou fai ai le leaga tele e malaia ai outou, ia faaumatia ia te outou le tane ma le fafine, o le tama itiiti ma le tama meamea, ai totonu o Iuta, ina ia le faatotoeina ni o outou;

verses.en: In that ye provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither ye be gone to dwell, that ye might cut yourselves off, and that ye might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?
verses.sm: ina ua outou faaonoono mai ia te au i mea ua faia e o outou lima, ua faamu mea manogi i atua ese i le nuu o Aikupito, ua outou o i ai e aumau ai, ina ia faaumatia outou, ma ia fai outou ma faafanoga e fai aʻi luma foi i nuu uma o le lalolagi?

verses.en: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.sm: Po ua galo ea ia te outou amio leaga a o outou tama, ma amio leaga a tupu o Iuta, ma amio leaga a latou ava, ma o outou amio leaga, ma amio leaga a outou ava, na latou faia i le nuu o Iuta, ma ala o lerusalema?

verses.en: They are not humbled even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.
verses.sm: E le tigaina o latou loto e oo i le aso nei, ma latou le fefefe, ma latou le savavali i laʻu tulafono, ma aʻu sauniga, na ou tuuina atu i o outou luma, ma luma o outou tama.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.
verses.sm: O le mea lea o loo faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le ALII o ‘au, le Atua o Isaraelu, Faauta, ou te faasaga oʻu mata ia te outou e malaia ai outou, ina ia faaumatia Iuta uma.

verses.en: And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.
verses.sm: Ou te ave foiieo totoe o luta, o e ua faasaga o latou mata e o atu i le nuu o Aikupito e aumau ai, e faaumatia foi i latou uma i le nuu o Aikupito; e oti i latou i le pelu ma le oge, e faaumatia i latou, o tagatanuu atoa ma alii; e oti i latou i le pelu ma le oge; e fai foi i latou ma faafanoga, ma mea e ofo ai, ma mea e fetuu ai, ma fai aʻi luma.

verses.en: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:
verses.sm: Aua ou te taui atu i e o nonofo i le nuu o Aikupito, e pei ona ou taui atu i Ierusalema i le pelu, ma le oge, ma le faamai;

verses.en: So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.
verses.sm: 0 e na totoe o Iuta, na o mai e aumau i lenei mea i le nuu o Aikupito, e leai se tasi e sao pe totoe, e toe foi atu i le nuu o luta, o le mea ua latou mananao tele ai e toe foi atu e nonofo ai; aua e leai ni e foi atu, na o e sosola lava.

verses.en: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea ia Jeremia o tagata uma o e na iloa ua faamuina mea manogi e a latou aua! atua ese, ma fafine uma na tutu mai, o le faapotopotoga tele, o le nuu uma foi sa nonofo i le nuu o Aikupito, i Patoro, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the LORD, we will not hearken unto thee.
verses.sm: O le upu ua e fai mai ai ia te i matou i le suafa o le AL11, matou te le faalogo ai lava ia te oe;

verses.en: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.
verses.sm: a e peitai matou te faia lava mea uma ua matou fai atu ai, e faamu mea manogi i le tupu fafine o le lagi, ma sasaa i ai taulaga i mea e inu, e pei ona matou faia, o i matou, ma o matou tama, o matou tupu, ma o matou alii, i aai o Iuta, ma ala o lerusalema; aua o ona po ia sa maoona ai i matou i mea e “ai, sa manuia foi, ma matou le iloa se malaia.

verses.en: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.
verses.sm: A e talu ina matou tuua ona faamu o mea manogi i le tupu fafine o le lagi, ma sasaa atu ia te ia taulaga i mea e inu, ua matou matitiva i mea uma, ua faaumatia foi i matou i le pelu ma le oge.

verses.en: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?
verses.sm: Na matou faamu mea manogi i le tupu fafine o le lagi, ma matou sasaa ia te ia taulaga i mea e inu, sa le i ai ea a matou tane ina ua matou faia mo ia ni ѓaapapa areto e auauna ia te ia, ma matou sasaa ia te ia taulaga i mea e inu?

verses.en: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him that answer, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o leremia i le nuu uma, o tane, ma fafine, ma le nuu uma e na tali mai ia te ia i lea upu, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, ye, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not the LORD remember them, and came it not into his mind?
verses.sm: O mea manogi na outou faamuina i aai o Iuta, ma ala o Ierusalema, o outou, ma o outou tama, ma o outou tupu, ma o outou alii, ma tagata o le nuu, na le manatua ea e le An lea mea? na le mafaufau ea o ia i ai?

verses.en: So that the LORD could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which ye have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.
verses.sm: Na le toe lava onosai le AL11, ona o le leaga o a outou amioga, ona o mea inosia na outou faia; o le mea lea ua fai ai lo outou nuu ma mea gaogao, ma mea e ofo ai, ma faafanoga, e leai se nofo ai, e pei ona fai i le aso nei.

verses.en: Because ye have burned incense, and because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.
verses.sm: Aua ua outou faamu mea manogi, aua foi ua outou agasala i le Atu, ma 4a outou le faalogo i le siufofoga o le Au, ma outou le savavali i lana tulafono, ma ana sauniga, ma ana poloaiga; o mea ia ua oo ai lenei malaia ia te outou, e pei ona fai i le aso nei.

verses.en: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah that are in the land of Egypt:
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Ieremia i le nuu uma, ma fafine uma, Ina faalogologo mai ia i le afioga a le AL11, o outou Iuta uma, o i le nuu o Aikupito;

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: ye will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.
verses.sm: o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le Aw! o “au, le Atua o Isaraelu, ua faapea mai, O outou ma a outou ava, ua outou tautala mai i o outou gutu, ua faataunuuina foi i o outou lima, ua faapea mai, Matou te faia lava a matou tautoga ua matou tauto ai, e faamu mea manogi i le tupu fafine o le lagi, ma sasaa ia te ia taulaga i mea e inu; e faatumauina lava e outou a outou tautoga, e matua faia foi e outou a outou tautoga.

verses.en: Therefore hear ye the word of the LORD, all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, saith the LORD, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The Lord GOD liveth.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ja faalogologo mai i le afioga a le ALI1, o outou Iuta uma o e o nonofo i le nuu o Aikupito; Faauta, ua ou tauto au i loʻu igoa tele, o loo 113I fetalai mai ai le ALII, e le toe taʻua loʻu igoa i le gutu o se tasi tagata o Iuta o loo iai i le nuu o Aikupito uma, e faapea, O loo soifua le Alii le ATUA.

verses.en: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.
verses.sm: Faauta, ou te mataala ia malaia i latou, a e le ina ia manuia; e faaumatia tagata uma o Iuta o e o i le nuu o Aikupito i le pelu, ma le faamai, seia faaumatia lava i latou.

verses.en: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, and all the remnant of Judah, that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or their's.
verses.sm: A o e sao i le pelu latou te foi atu nai le nuu 0 Aikupito i le nuu o Iuta, e toaitiiti i latou; e iloa foi e Iuta uma o e totoe, e ua o atu i le nuu o Aikupito e aumau ai, po o upu a ai e taunuu, po o aʻu, po o a latou.

verses.en: And this shall be a sign unto you, saith the LORD, that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:
verses.sm: O lenei foi Je faailoga ia te outou, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII, e tauia outou e aʻu i lenei mea, ina ia outou iloa e matua taunuu aʻu upu ia te outou ia malaia ai outou.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give Pharaoh-hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Faauta, ou te tuuina atu Farao Hofero le tupu o Aikupito i lima o e ua ita mai ia te ia, ma lima o e saili e fasioti ia te ia; e pei ona ou tuuina atu o Setekaia le tupu o Iuta i le lima o Nepukanesa le tupu o
